name: Chimeneas (Spain)
description: Yellow field gyronny at the hoist with a green triangle issuing from the hoist to the fly bearing a white castle of three towers.
history: Chimeneas adopted its arms and flag officially on 19 July 2001; the flag is rectangular, gyronny at the hoist, of 2:3, the central triangle green charged with a white castle masoned and open in black donjoned of three towers.

features.role: central triangle from the hoist edge to the fly
castle masoned and open in black, donjoned of three towers
